scope: Cleared lysates were incubated with equilibrated beads by end-over-end rotation for 3 h at 4 °C to enrich for biotinylated proteins.
After affinity purification, beads were pelleted by centrifugation at 500×g for 2 min.
Pre-cleared lysates were subsequently incubated with 100 µL probe-bound beads for 3 h at 4 °C with end-over-end rotation.
After capture, beads were washed three times with 1 mL unsupplemented ChIRP lysis buffer, three times with 1 mL trypsin digest buffer, and finally dissolved in 20 µL 20 mM Tris–HCl pH 8.0.
